Information

Current RbbP version: 1.7.6 (2026-08-21)

This mod is built for MULTIPLAYER games; balance changes are aimed at a comfortable experience against other players.

Victory conditions

Seals Victory:

  • Reduced points required

Magic Victory:

  • Ancient Wonder ritual spell:
    • Available upon unlocking a T3 tome
    • Reduced cast cost
    • Reduced required 1500 -> 250
  • Age of Magic ritual spell:
    • Available upon unlocking a T3 tome
    • Reduced cast cost
    • Reduced required 3000 -> 500

Expansion Victory:

  • Reduced number of sectors required
  • Reduced build cost of the Unity Beacon:
    • 280 750 → 170 450

Realm traits

Umbral Abyss

  • Pickups:
    • Guard strength increased: Medium -> Strong
    • Tome Fragment now only unlocks spells from the Tome of Eldritch Pact:
      • Summon Umbral Juggernaut
      • Ritual of the Gloomveil
      • Pall of Gloom
      • Umbral Exile
      • Umbral Rift
  • Fixes:
    • Umbral resource nodes: rolling back a turn in multiplayer used to duplicate the resource income from these nodes. Chitinous Growths 30 . Monoliths 30

Crystal Dwelling

  • Trade:
    • Removed Strategic Artifacts.
    • Lithorine Shardlancer and Lithorine Core swapped trade slots.
  • Quests:
    • Removed item-crafting quests.
    • Reward for declining a quest reduced 4x.

Shrouded Isles

  • Move Portal action:
    • Can now only target a tile within a province that has a city

(New) Consequences of Defeat

  • Optional realm trait
  • When a player is defeated or surrenders, all cities belonging to them and their vassals are instantly destroyed (no ruins left behind). Exception: cities currently under siege.

Strategic map

Theme

Sunless

  • Reduced combat healing penalty: 50% -> 10%

Map generation (RMG)

  • Increased distance between players on Standard and Close map settings.
  • Coast map type: reduced share of sea regions.

Lost Soul

  • Changed army compositions for these quests (Fair Lady Enemy, Philosopher's Stone, Blighted Village, Headless Horseman, Headless Horseman Graveyard):

Traders

    • White Wolf Mount: price reduced 200 -> 100

      • Target enemy army loses -20% -> -3%
  • Global spell - Mass Phantasmal Ritual:
    • Changed effect:

  • Active ability – Eldritch Phase I

  • Active ability – Eldritch Phase II
    • On cooldown at the start of battle: 1

    • Forge:
      • Passive effect – Rune of Creation: Rock

    • Now once per battle

    • No longer reduces the ability's cooldown
  • Affinity-specific ability - Hemomancer
    • Active ability – Blood Empowerment:
      • The ability's cooldown can no longer be reduced

Lords

Created leaders

Observer:

  • Non-customizable leader
  • Can be selected in any game (not recommended for story-driven realms)
  • Multiple Observers can be selected
  • If AI-controlled, loses immediately at game start
  • Loses its starting city and army at the start (without losing the game)
  • No extra free city of the same faction is placed on the map
  • Never appears in random selection
  • Cannot cast spells or rituals
  • All per-turn resource income = 0
  • Has no Whispering Stones
  • Receives a one-time resource grant at the start:
    • 999999
    • 999999
    • 99999
    • 99999
    • 10 of every Magic Material
  • Forge functionality unlocked
  • Cannot declare war/treaty/pact/alliance with players
  • Players cannot declare war/treaty/pact/alliance with the Observer
  • Diplomatic status with other players is permanently Neutral
  • Resource and artifact trading is available in diplomacy
  • Can create quests
  • Full map visibility
  • Sees players' hidden units
  • Does not see hidden neutral units

Heroes

  • All heroes gained a passive ability - Insanity Immunity
  • Updated hireable hero pool
    • Reduced price 100 -> 30
    • Reduced refresh period 5 -> 3
  • Hero revival
    • Changed cost

      • 20 + 10 per level -> 40 + 20 per level
